development.source: Previously seen v6 B development; private input stays outside public checkout
development.composition: 20 online decisions including two R69 follow-ups, plus four negative Slav regressions
development.clocks: Original recorded actual remaining clocks and complete observable histories
development.reuse_teacher: Existing 4M-node cold forced-move labels; only new selected move union needs labels
development.raw_results: Private data/online/teacher-v8; publish aggregate anonymous summaries only

holdout.selection: Existing v6 B reservation: first 24 valid standard >=60-ply games with both ratings >=2500 in source order; one alternating ply36/49 position per game; no engine-result filter
holdout.configuration_selection: V7 and one development-selected configuration; require recorded source hash/configuration freeze before running
holdout.labels: Unsearched/unlabelled at declaration; bounded teacher labels only after candidate configuration freezes
holdout.separation: Entire February source was excluded from January/online development; whole games never cross sets
holdout.scope: Independent human middlegame positions, not a tactical puzzle gold standard

interpretation: Use complete depth, time, nodes, TT/LMR counters, teacher regret and actual match results together
Teacher mate and centipawn scores stay separate; multiple equivalent moves are accepted
No match gate claim when teacher labels or required rows are missing
No retuning against final holdout and no resampling on an unfavorable result
